title: Picked up a great amount of dirt
text:
Picked up a great amount of dirt. I only have one large area rug, and a couch; the rest of my floor is concrete.

Picked up a great amount of dirt, but by the 4th month is started to lose suction. This is with regular cleaning.

At month 6 is started to be more of a hindrance than a convenience. It just shot dirt everywhere and didn't pick up anything (again, just one floor rug).

I gave up on the unit after about 3 attempts to dissemble it clean every part.

I should have put my money somewhere else.
